# proxmox_sdn_prefix_list (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN prefix list from `/cluster/sdn/prefix-lists`. Entries stay Proxmox property strings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_prefix_list" "app" {
  prefix_list_id = proxmox_sdn_prefix_list.app.prefix_list_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `prefix_list_id` (String) Prefix list to read.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (List of String)
- `id` (String) Prefix list identifier.
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `state` (String)
